# Clean & Shiny

> Insured and bonded residential and commercial cleaning service in Chicago, Illinois and surrounding suburbs. Owner-operated by Maria Vazquez, in business for over 10 years and grown by referral. Legal name: Clean & Shiny LLC. Also written as "Clean and Shiny".

## Services
- Standard (regular) residential cleaning — starts at $180
- Deep cleaning — starts at $280. Oven, refrigerator and cabinet interiors available at additional cost.
- Move-in / move-out cleaning — includes refrigerator interior, ovens, and cabinets inside and out
- Post-construction cleaning
- Commercial cleaning

Final prices depend on the condition, size and distance of the location. Quotes are free.

## Service area
Chicago and surrounding suburbs, within about 40 miles.

## Insurance
Fully insured and bonded.

## Hours
Monday through Saturday, 6am to 5pm.

## Payment
Cash, Zelle, Cash App, card, and check.
